CustomField.formula:
/*IF(TEXT( ApprovalStatus__c ) = 'Approved', 'Line_Editor_Aproved', 'SBQQ__LineEditor')*/
IF( AND( TEXT(ApprovalStatus__c) = "Approved", SR_Lines_Count__c <= 0, Toronto_Lines_Count__c <= 0 ), "Line_Editor_Aproved",
IF( AND( SR_Lines_Count__c <= 0, Toronto_Lines_Count__c > 0 ), "LDGI_Line_Editor",
IF( SR_Lines_Count__c > 0, "SR_Line_Editor", "SBQQ__LineEditor" ) ) )
